evidence.text: Anadarko is currently only producing the Amp 2 Upper.
Anadarko is currently only producing the Amp 2 Upper.

text:
Per the approved APM, Anadarko permitted to attempt to open the XRFV in the Amp 2 Lower, flow test the Amp 2 Lower, and then change to the Amp 2 Upper. Anadarko was able to achieve a successful negative test. Anadarko is currently only producing the Amp 2 Upper.

Anadarko set the optional pump-thru plug in the XRFV to isolate the Amp 2 Lower. The plug was set above the Amp 2 Lower mechanical sleeve. The sleeve for the Amp 2 Lower is a Superior X-Radial Flow Valve. Anadarko achieved a successful test on the plug, so we know the Amp 2 Lower is isolated. 

First we ran a check set tool that showed the plug was actually set. Then we performed the negative test by pulling > 500 psi off the plug and holding.

Since Anadarko has the lower frac pack isolated via plug and the successful negative test, then a commingling application has not been submitted to date. Should Anadarko decide to produce both the Amp 2 Lower and Amp 2 Upper in the future, then BSEE-Rate Control would be consulted prior to doing so.

The well was plugged back by setting an inflatable cmt retainer @ 5109' MD and setting 1524' balance cmt plug on top of the retainer, ETOC @ 3585'.  A 9 5/8" EZSV was then set at 3438' and 400 sxs of cmt were squeezed below to retainer to set a cmt plug from 3585' - 3438'MD.  Operations were completed on the well on 05-25-10.
